title: Introducing Grok 4.6
evidence_basis: Official xAI product release documentation and API pricing schedule.
confirmed_fact: xAI released Grok 4.6 on August 12, 2026, featuring a 500,000-token context window and specific tiered pricing that doubles for requests exceeding 200,000 tokens.
interpretation: xAI is positioning Grok 4.6 as an affordable frontier alternative for multi-step agent coding, though developers must manage context window size to avoid automated pricing spikes.

title: Introducing Delta — Zed's Blog
evidence_basis: Official product announcement and technical documentation for DeltaDB.
confirmed_fact: Zed Industries launched the private beta for Delta, a collaborative coding environment using DeltaDB to track operation-level changes and link edits to agent transcripts.
interpretation: Operation-level version control that anchors comments to stable code objects offers a viable solution to the human code-review bottleneck created by autonomous coding agents.

title: Twitch Now Trains Amazon's Generative AI Models on Your Channel By Default
evidence_basis: Twitch account security interface, official Twitch patch notes livestream recording with CPO Mike Minton.
confirmed_fact: Twitch enabled a 'Training for Generative AI' setting by default on August 12, 2026, permitting Amazon to collect channel data for model training.
interpretation: Platforms continue to rely on default opt-in policies for AI data harvesting, placing the burden of privacy and IP protection entirely on individual creators.

source_name: Drexel University / Transactions of the ACL
title: What Do People Really Think About Generative AI?
evidence_basis: Peer-reviewed study published in Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics (TACL).
confirmed_fact: A study of 230,000 Reddit posts found that 31% of users trust generative AI, 26% distrust it, and 41% remain neutral.
interpretation: Public sentiment toward generative AI remains fundamentally divided, indicating that user trust must be actively earned through reliable performance rather than assumed.
